title: Gameplay Prototypes
description: Projects that I worked on very specific things but are not full games

items.title: Multiplayer Building Game
items.subtitle: Server-Authoritative Netcode & NPC Decision Trees
work_done: Created a multiplayer system where multiple people could build in the same town.
Made a voting system where players could vote on what the NPCs would prioritize in building and doing.
Created a building system where players could place buildings if the town had the available resources in storage buildings.
Created an AI system where NPCs could automatically pathfind where resources are stored and moved to where they could build.
Used LimboAI to make a decision tree where NPCs controlled themselves based on the priority system.
Created a full authoritative dedicated server made with C# and JavaScript with database access.
